57 template <class T>
58 static std::shared_ptr<beerocks_header>
59 add_intel_vs_data(std::shared_ptr<ieee1905_1::tlvVendorSpecific> tlv, uint16_t id = 0)
60 {
61 // Allocate maximum allowed length for the payload, so it can accommodate variable length
62 // data inside the internal TLV list.
63 // On finalize(), the buffer is shrunk back to its real size.
64 size_t payload_length =
65 tlv->getBuffRemainingBytes() - ieee1905_1::tlvEndOfMessage::get_initial_size();
66 if (!tlv->alloc_payload(payload_length)) {
67 std::cout << "beerocks_message.h[ " << __LINE__ << "]: " << __FUNCTION__ << " failed!"
68 << std::endl;
69 return nullptr;
70 }
71 std::shared_ptr<beerocks_header> hdr =
72 std::make_shared<beerocks_header>(tlv->payload(), tlv->payload_length(), false);
73 if (!hdr)
74 return nullptr;
75 if (!hdr->addClass<beerocks_message::cACTION_HEADER>())
76 return nullptr;
77 if (!hdr->addClass<T>())
78 return nullptr;
79
80 beerocks_message::eAction action = beerocks_message::eAction::ACTION_NONE;
81 auto action_op = hdr->getClass<T>()->get_action_op();
82 if (typeid(action_op) == typeid(beerocks_message::eActionOp_1905_VS))
83 action = beerocks_message::eAction::ACTION_1905_VS;
84 else if (typeid(action_op) == typeid(beerocks_message::eActionOp_CONTROL))
85 action = beerocks_message::eAction::ACTION_CONTROL;
86 else if (typeid(action_op) == typeid(beerocks_message::eActionOp_PLATFORM))
87 action = beerocks_message::eAction::ACTION_PLATFORM;
88 else if (typeid(action_op) == typeid(beerocks_message::eActionOp_BACKHAUL))
89 action = beerocks_message::eAction::ACTION_BACKHAUL;
90 else if (typeid(action_op) == typeid(beerocks_message::eActionOp_APMANAGER))
91 action = beerocks_message::eAction::ACTION_APMANAGER;
92 else if (typeid(action_op) == typeid(beerocks_message::eActionOp_MONITOR))
93 action = beerocks_message::eAction::ACTION_MONITOR;
94 else if (typeid(action_op) == typeid(beerocks_message::eActionOp_CLI))
95 action = beerocks_message::eAction::ACTION_CLI;
96 else if (typeid(action_op) == typeid(beerocks_message::eActionOp_BML))
97 action = beerocks_message::eAction::ACTION_BML;
98
99 if (action == beerocks_message::eAction::ACTION_NONE) {
100 std::cout << "beerocks_message.h[ " << __LINE__ << "]: " << __FUNCTION__ << " failed!"
101 << std::endl;
102 return nullptr;
103 }
104
105 hdr->actionhdr()->action() = (beerocks_message::eAction)action;
106 hdr->actionhdr()->action_op() = action_op;
107 hdr->actionhdr()->id() = id;
108 tlv->addInnerClassList(hdr);
109
110 return hdr;
111 }

113 template <class T>
114 static std::shared_ptr<T> create_vs_message(ieee1905_1::CmduMessageTx &cmdu_tx, uint16_t id = 0)
115 {
116 auto cmduhdr = cmdu_tx.create(0, ieee1905_1::eMessageType::VENDOR_SPECIFIC_MESSAGE);
117 if (!cmduhdr) {
118 std::cout << "beerocks_message.h[ " << __LINE__ << "]: " << __FUNCTION__ << " failed!"
119 << std::endl;
120 return nullptr;
121 }
122
123 return add_vs_tlv<T>(cmdu_tx, id);
124 }
125
126 template <class T>
127 static std::shared_ptr<T> add_vs_tlv(ieee1905_1::CmduMessageTx &cmdu_tx, uint16_t id = 0)
128 {
129 auto tlvhdr = cmdu_tx.add_vs_tlv(ieee1905_1::tlvVendorSpecific::eVendorOUI::OUI_INTEL);
130 if (!tlvhdr) {
131 std::cout << "beerocks_message.h[ " << __LINE__ << "]: " << __FUNCTION__ << " failed!"
132 << std::endl;
133 return nullptr;
134 }
135
136 auto beerocks_header = add_intel_vs_data<T>(tlvhdr, id);
137 if (!beerocks_header)
138 return nullptr;
139
140 // According to C++'03 Standard 14.2/4:
141 // When the name of a member template specialization appears after . or -> in a postfix-expression,
142 // or after nested-name-specifier in a qualified-id, and the postfix-expression or qualified-id
143 // explicitly depends on a template-parameter (14.6.2), the member template name must be prefixed by
144 // the keyword template. Otherwise the name is assumed to name a non-template.
145 return beerocks_header->template getClass<T>();
146 }
